name: wpr-scrcpy
description: WprScrcpy GUI and ADB Controller with Wi-Fi Debugging QR Code and Terminal

scripts.build: npx electron-packager . WprScrcpy --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=smartphone.ico --overwrite --out=dist --app-version=4.0.0 --ignore="(\.git|dist|scratch|get_scrcpy_bounds\.cs|get_scrcpy_bounds\.ps1|create_shortcut\.ps1|Chay_AeroScrcpy\.bat|\.zip|\.rar)" && powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path dist/WprScrcpy-v4.0.0) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist/WprScrcpy-v4.0.0 }; Rename-Item -Path dist/WprScrcpy-win32-x64 -NewName WprScrcpy-v4.0.0; if (Test-Path dist/WprScrcpy-v4.0.0.zip) { Remove-Item -Force dist/WprScrcpy-v4.0.0.zip }; Compress-Archive -Path dist/WprScrcpy-v4.0.0 -DestinationPath dist/WprScrcpy-v4.0.0.zip"

author: Antigravity
